sources.title: Field failure to navigation policy improvement
sources.excerpt: Promotion requires a strictly positive primary mean improvement at least its sealed `minimum_improvement`, and no individual scenario/seed/metric degradation beyond that metric's `maximum_regression`.

options.text: Any positive improvement on the primary metric, regardless of how small, as long as it is nonzero
options.explanation: The comparison requires the improvement to reach the sealed minimum_improvement bound, not merely be positive by any amount.

options.text: A strictly positive primary mean improvement at least the sealed `minimum_improvement`, with no metric's degradation beyond its `maximum_regression`
options.explanation: Correct. The decision requires a strictly positive primary mean improvement at least the sealed minimum_improvement, with no scenario/seed/metric degrading beyond that metric's maximum_regression.

options.text: An improvement measured only on the training-exposed replay cohort, since that cohort is diagnostic
options.explanation: The training-exposed replay cohort is diagnostic only; the decision is a sealed comparison over the declared metrics and bounds, not a training-exposed-only check.

options.text: Every secondary metric must independently clear its own `minimum_improvement` as well
options.explanation: Secondary metrics are regression guards whose minimum_improvement is only informational unless one is selected as the primary metric.
